name: }IDE.Version.Copy
description: Copies one version into another across every cube carrying the version dimension: static (frozen snapshot under Non-Calculating) or calculating (inputs only, rules rebuild). One generic core TI, no Bedrock. Full documentation in the Prolog header.

parameters.Name: pSource
parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: version to copy FROM - a leaf element of the version dimension (e.g. Forecast)

parameters.Name: pTarget
parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: version to copy TO (e.g. FCST 2026-04). Must not exist for pMode=new; must exist for pMode=replace

parameters.Name: pMode
parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: new = create the target version | replace = the target exists; clear it and copy again

parameters.Name: pType
parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: static = frozen copy of every value, target put under pStaticParent | calculating = copy input cells only, rules recalculate

parameters.Name: pVersionDim
parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: version dimension (e.g. WFP Version). Blank = SYS Settings 'Version Dimension' for pApp, then All

parameters.Name: pStaticParent
parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: consolidation that marks a version static, which the rule guards test (default Non-Calculating)

parameters.Name: pInputCubes
parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: calculating copies only - cubes to copy, | separated. Blank = every cube carrying the version dimension

parameters.Name: pExcludeCubes
parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: cubes never copied, | separated (e.g. WFP Control). Blank = SYS Settings 'Version Exclude Cubes'

parameters.Name: pStatus
parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: value written to the target's status attribute. Blank = Approved (static) or Working (calculating)

parameters.Name: pTypeAttr
parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: version attribute that records the type (default Version Type). Skipped if the dimension has no such attribute

parameters.Name: pStatusAttr
parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: version attribute that records the status (default Status). Skipped if the dimension has no such attribute

parameters.Name: pCube
parameters.Prompt: INTERNAL: leave blank. The process sets it when it calls itself once per cube

parameters.Name: pApp
parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: application row in SYS Settings used for blank defaults (default WFP)
